stem: A 30-year-old woman presents with 6 weeks of amenorrhea, mild vaginal bleeding, and intermittent lower abdominal pain. Her quantitative serum bhCG is 3,600 mIU/mL, and transvaginal ultrasound shows an empty uterus with no adnexal mass or free fluid. What is the most likely diagnosis?
options: Intrauterine pregnancy too early to visualize
Complete miscarriage
Molar pregnancy
Ectopic pregnancy
explanationAr: بما أن قيمة bhCG أعلى من المنطقة التمييزية (discriminatory zone تقارب 1500–2000 mIU/mL) مع غياب الحمل داخل الرحم على الإيكو المهبلي، فيجب الاشتباه بقوة بالحمل خارج الرحم (ectopic pregnancy) ومتابعة bhCG التسلسلي.

stem: A 32-year-old woman with 7 weeks of amenorrhea collapses with severe abdominal pain and left shoulder-tip pain. On arrival she is hypotensive (BP 82/50 mmHg) and tachycardic (HR 128/min) with generalized abdominal peritonism, and bedside ultrasound shows a large volume of free intraperitoneal fluid. What is the most appropriate immediate management?
options: Immediate emergency surgery (resuscitative laparotomy or laparoscopy)
Intramuscular methotrexate
Repeat quantitative bhCG in 48 hours
Blood transfusion with inpatient observation
explanationAr: علامات تمزق الحمل المنتبذ (ألم الكتف المُحال، انخفاض الضغط، سائل حر بالبطن) تستدعي جراحة طارئة فورية مع الإنعاش المتزامن. وإذا كانت المريضة سالبة العامل الريصي (Rh-negative) يجب إعطاؤها Anti-D لمنع التحسس.

stem: A 22-year-old sexually active woman has lower abdominal pain, cervical motion tenderness, and mucopurulent discharge, consistent with pelvic inflammatory disease. She is haemodynamically stable and tolerating oral intake. Which finding is an indication for hospital admission?
options: Oral temperature of 38.0°C
Tubo-ovarian abscess on pelvic ultrasound
Mucopurulent cervical discharge
White cell count of 11,500/mm3
explanationAr: من معايير إدخال المريضة بالمرض الالتهابي الحوضي (PID) للمستشفى: الحمل، المرض الشديد أو خراج أنبوبي-مبيضي (tubo-ovarian abscess)، عدم تحمل العلاج الفموي، أو فشل العلاج الخارجي. درجة الحرارة 38.0 وحدها لا تكفي.

stem: A 17-year-old girl presents with sudden severe right lower abdominal pain and vomiting. Examination reveals a very tender right adnexal mass, and Doppler ultrasound shows absent ovarian blood flow. What is the most appropriate next step?
options: Combined oral contraceptives to suppress the ovary
Outpatient oral analgesia with gynecology follow-up
Urgent laparoscopy for detorsion of the adnexa
Contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen and pelvis
explanationAr: التواء المبيض (ovarian torsion) حالة إسعافية جراحية؛ الجراحة العاجلة (غالباً laparoscopy مع detorsion) ضرورية لإنقاذ المبيض، وغياب التدفق الدموي على الدوبلر يدعم التشخيص لكنه لا يؤخر الجراحة.

stem: A 32-year-old woman at 34 weeks' gestation presents with a generalized tonic-clonic seizure, BP 168/112 mmHg, hyperreflexia, and proteinuria. The seizure has now stopped and she is being closely monitored. Which medication is most appropriate to prevent recurrent seizures?
options: Phenytoin 1 g IV
Magnesium sulfate 4 g IV loading dose
Labetalol 20 mg IV
Immediate delivery by cesarean before any medical treatment
explanationAr: كبريتات المغنيسيوم (magnesium sulfate) بجرعة تحميل 4 غ وريدياً على مدى 5–10 دقائق هي العلاج المعياري للاختلاج في تسمم الحمل (eclampsia) ولمنع النكس، وليس الفينيتوين أو خافضات الضغط وحدها.

stem: A 26-year-old woman at 28 weeks' gestation suffers an in-hospital cardiac arrest. High-quality CPR with manual left uterine displacement started immediately, and reversible causes were addressed; after 4 minutes there is no return of spontaneous circulation. What is the most appropriate next step?
options: Continue CPR alone and reassess after another 15 minutes
Transport immediately without further on-scene interventions
Start perimortem cesarean delivery at the site of the arrest
Declare death and terminate resuscitation
explanationAr: عند توقف القلب لدى حامل بحمل ≥20 أسبوعاً يجب البدء بالقيصرية الطارئة (perimortem cesarean) خلال 4 دقائق من بدء الإنعاش دون تأخيره، لأن هذا يحسّن نتائج الأم والجنين معاً.

stem: A 79-year-old woman presents with 2 hours of shortness of breath, fatigue, diaphoresis, and mild epigastric discomfort without chest pain. She is pale and anxious. What is the most appropriate immediate action?
options: Reassurance, antacids, and discharge with general practitioner follow-up
CT pulmonary angiogram as the first test
An anxiolytic with a short period of observation
A 12-lead ECG within 10 minutes and cardiac troponin
explanationAr: قد يُقدَم كبار السن باحتشاء العضلة القلبية بأعراض غير نمطية (ضيق نفس، تعرق، ألم شرسوفي) دون ألم صدري. المطلوب تخطيط قلب (ECG) خلال 10 دقائق من الوصول مع قياس التروبونين.

stem: A 74-year-old man on warfarin for atrial fibrillation presents after a mechanical fall from standing height. He has a GCS of 15 with no focal neurological deficits, and the examination is otherwise unremarkable. What is the most appropriate management?
options: Urgent non-contrast CT of the head
Discharge with written head-injury advice
Admission for 24-hour observation without imaging
Skull radiographs
explanationAr: في رضوض كبار السن يجب خفض عتبة التصوير المقطعي للرأس (CT) خاصة مع مضادات التخثر كالوارفارين، لأن تحت-الفرز (undertriage) شائع ومخطئ ويفوّت النزف داخل القحف رغم فحص عصبي طبيعي.

stem: A 28-year-old woman at 30 weeks' gestation is brought to the trauma bay after a motor vehicle crash. While supine she becomes hypotensive (BP 88/54 mmHg) and dizzy, and her symptoms improve when her position changes. What is the most appropriate immediate intervention?
options: Position her in Trendelenburg
Immediate emergency cesarean delivery in the trauma bay
Left lateral tilt or manual uterine displacement
An IV vasopressor infusion
explanationAr: الرحم الحامل الكبير يسبب انضغاطاً أبهرياً-أجوفيّاً (aortocaval compression) في وضعية الاستلقاء فينخفض العائد الوريدي. الحل هو الإمالة الجانبية اليسرى أو إزاحة الرحم يدوياً (manual uterine displacement).

stem: A 42-year-old man with a BMI of 58 kg/m2 requires rapid sequence intubation after major trauma. Which physiological change is most critical to anticipate during preoxygenation and apnea?
options: Rapid arterial desaturation during apnea because of reduced functional residual capacity
Reduced oxygen consumption compared with lean patients
Slower desaturation because of increased chest wall compliance
A lower risk of pulmonary aspiration
explanationAr: في السمنة المفرطة تنخفض السعة الوظيفية المتبقية (FRC) ويزيد استهلاك الأكسجين فيحدث نقص تشبع سريع أثناء انقطاع النفس. يلزم preoxygenation مثالي بوضعية مناسبة مع ضبط الجرعات (مثل succinylcholine بالوزن الكلي).

stem: A 65-year-old man with a gastrointestinal bleed refuses blood transfusion on religious grounds. He is alert and oriented and gives a consistent, reasoned explanation for his refusal. When formally assessing his decision-making capacity, which element must be present?
options: Agreement with the treating team's recommendation
The ability to understand the information, appreciate its implications, reason about the options, and communicate a consistent choice
A formal psychiatric consultation before any refusal is accepted
Written consent from the next of kin
explanationAr: تقييم الأهلية لاتخاذ القرار (capacity) يعتمد على أربعة عناصر: الفهم، وتقدير الموقف وعواقبه، والاستدلال، والتعبير عن اختيار متسق. ولا يشترط موافقة الطبيب النفسي ولا موافقة الأقارب.

stem: A 45-year-old unconscious man is brought to the emergency department with a tension pneumothorax and severe hypotension. No family members are present and no advance directive can be found. What is the most appropriate action?
options: Delay the procedure until a court order is obtained
Ask the police to provide consent
Withhold treatment until a relative can be reached
Proceed with the life-saving procedure under implied consent
explanationAr: في الحالة الإسعافية المهددة للحياة مع فقدان الأهلية وغياب أي توكيل أو أقارب، تُفترض الموافقة الضمنية (implied consent) ويتقدم الطبيب بالعلاج المنقذ للحياة فوراً.

stem: A 7-year-old girl is brought in with patterned loop-shaped bruises on her back, and her mother's explanation does not match the injuries. The parents ask you not to tell anyone. What is the most appropriate action?
options: Report the suspicion to child protection services as a mandatory obligation
Respect the parents' request for confidentiality and discharge the child home
Obtain the parents' written consent before making any report
Discharge home with advice to return if further bruises appear
explanationAr: الاشتباه بإساءة معاملة الطفل يفرض واجب الإبلاغ الإلزامي (mandatory reporting) لسلطات حماية الطفل، حتى بالاشتباه فقط ودون موافقة الأهل وبغض النظر عن رغبتهم بالسرية.

stem: You are handing over a 68-year-old septic patient to the ICU team at shift change. Which of the following handovers best follows the SBAR structure?
options: 'He is very sick; please come and see him whenever you can.'
'He arrived by ambulance at noon; let me tell you the whole day from the beginning.'

'Mr. K, 68, septic shock: BP 85/40 and confused for 2 hours (situation); diabetic with CKD (background); responding poorly to fluids (assessment); needs ICU admission and central access now (recommendation).'
'Blood pressure 85 over 40 — that is all I know about him.'
explanationAr: تسليم SBAR يضم أربعة عناصر: الموقف (Situation)، الخلفية (Background)، التقييم (Assessment)، والتوصية (Recommendation). هذا الهيكل الموحد يقلل أخطاء التسليم وينقل المعلومات الحرجة بوضوح.

stem: An 80-year-old man with a valid, documented DNR order in his chart suffers a cardiac arrest. His family arrives and demands that full resuscitation be performed. What is the most appropriate action?
options: Perform full resuscitation because the family demands it
Wait for a court decision before acting
Stop all treatment, including oxygen and analgesia
Honor the valid DNR, continue comfort-focused care, and explain the decision to the family
explanationAr: تعليمات عدم الإنعاش الموثقة والسارية (DNR) يجب احترامها رغم اعتراض العائلة. ولا تعني DNR إيقاف الرعاية الأخرى؛ تُستمر الرعاية التلطيفية والأكسجين والمسكنات مع شرح الأمر للعائلة بتعاطف.

stem: A 58-year-old woman receiving chemotherapy for breast cancer presents with a temperature of 38.9°C. Her absolute neutrophil count is 250/mm3 and blood cultures are drawn. What is the most appropriate immediate management?
options: Wait for culture and sensitivity results before starting antibiotics
Start empiric IV broad-spectrum antibiotics (for example, cefepime) immediately, within 1 hour
Give paracetamol and reassess the temperature trend
Start antibiotics only if the ANC falls below 100/mm3
explanationAr: الحمى مع قلة العدلات (febrile neutropenia) حالة طارئة؛ تبدأ مضادات حيوية واسعة الطيف وريدية (مثل cefepime) خلال ساعة واحدة من الحرارة دون انتظار مزارع الدم أو أي عتبة أدنى للعدلات.

stem: A 24-year-old man with sickle cell disease presents with severe low back and bone pain. He is afebrile with an oxygen saturation of 94% on room air and no evidence of infection or acute chest syndrome. What is the most appropriate initial management?
options: Prompt IV opioid analgesia within 1 hour plus isotonic IV hydration
Urgent exchange transfusion before analgesia
Oral ibuprofen alone with discharge home
IM pethidine on demand every 6 hours
explanationAr: أزمة الانسداد الوعائي المنجلية تعالَج بمسكنات أفيونية وريدية سريعة (خلال ساعة من الوصول) مع محاليل وريدية متساوية التوتر وأكسجين عند الحاجة. التبديل الدموي محفوظ للمضاعفات الشديدة، ويعطى pethidine بالوريد لا بالعضل.

stem: Ten minutes into a red cell transfusion, a 60-year-old man develops fever, rigors, flank pain, and dark urine, and his BP falls to 90/60 mmHg. What is the first action you should take?
options: Slow the infusion rate and give an antipyretic
Continue the transfusion and add an antihistamine
Stop the transfusion immediately and keep the IV line open with normal saline
Complete the unit and send the patient home with observation advice
explanationAr: هذه أعراض تفاعل انحلال الدم الحاد بالانتقال (acute hemolytic transfusion reaction)؛ يجب إيقاف النقل فوراً وإبقاء الخط الوريدي بمحلول ملحي وإرسال عينات الدم والبول للتحقق.

stem: A 45-year-old man with newly diagnosed Burkitt lymphoma starts chemotherapy. Two days later, laboratory results show potassium 6.6 mmol/L, uric acid 13.2 mg/dL, phosphate 7.8 mg/dL, calcium 7.0 mg/dL, and a rising creatinine. What is the most appropriate management?
options: Calcium gluconate infusion with potassium replacement
Furosemide as the sole intervention
Immediate dialysis without any other measures
Aggressive isotonic IV hydration plus rasburicase or allopurinol
explanationAr: هذه متلازمة تحلل الورم (tumor lysis syndrome): ارتفاع البوتاسيوم وحامض اليوريك والفوسفات مع نقص الكالسيوم. علاجها الأساسي إماهة وريدية مكثفة مع allopurinol أو rasburicase قبل وأثناء العلاج الكيميائي، وتصحيح فرط البوتاسيوم.

stem: At a mass-casualty scene, you are using START triage. A non-ambulatory adult victim has a respiratory rate of 34/min, an absent radial pulse, and does not obey commands. To which triage category should this victim be assigned?
options: Red (immediate)
Yellow (delayed)
Green (minor)
Black (deceased/expectant)
explanationAr: في فرز START، معدل التنفس >30 أو غياب النبض الكعبري أو عدم الاستجابة للأوامر يضع الضحية في الفئة الحمراء (immediate). هؤلاء هم ذوو الأولوية القصوى للعلاج والنقل، بينما المشاة يدخلون الأخضر.

stem: You are the first ambulance crew to arrive at a bus crash with approximately 20 casualties of varying severity. What is the most appropriate first action?
options: Begin CPR on the first unconscious casualty you encounter
Load the two nearest casualties and transport them at once
Wait on scene for the medical director before taking any action
Ensure scene safety, declare a mass-casualty incident, and establish unified command with a triage officer
explanationAr: أول فريق يصل يؤمّن أمان المشهد ثم يعلن حادثاً جماعياً (MCI) ويؤسس قيادة موحدة (unified command) مع تعيين ضابط فرز (triage officer) قبل بدء أي علاج فردي أو نقل.

stem: You are transferring a trauma patient to the resuscitation team. Which prehospital handover best follows the ATMIST format?
options: 'He is critically ill and needs help quickly.'
'Male trauma patient; age unknown; no further information available.'
'38-year-old man; rollover crash 20 minutes ago; suspected femur and chest injuries; BP 90/60, RR 28, GCS 14; splints and chest seal applied with one IV line running.'
'He was trapped for a while; my partner will tell you the rest later.'
explanationAr: تسليم ATMIST يضم: العمر (Age)، وقت الحادث (Time)، آلية الإصابة (Mechanism)، الإصابات المكتشفة (Injuries)، العلامات الحيوية (Signs)، والمعالجة المقدمة (Treatment)؛ وهو تسليم منظم يمنع فوات معلومات حرجة.

stem: A 22-year-old woman presents after taking an overdose, stating she 'wanted to end it all.' She describes 3 weeks of low mood, a specific plan, access to lethal means, a previous suicide attempt last year, and she lives alone; her medical condition is now stable. What is the most appropriate disposition?
options: Discharge with a written promise not to harm herself
Inpatient psychiatric admission (formal if she declines) with safety planning and means restriction
Routine outpatient psychiatric follow-up in two weeks
Referral to a general counselor for stress management
explanationAr: وجود خطة محددة ووسيلة متاحة وسابقة محاولة وعزلة اجتماعية يشير إلى خطر انتحاري مرتفع يستدعي الإدخال النفسي (رسمياً إذا رفضت) مع خطة سلامة (safety planning) وتقييد الوصول إلى الوسائل الخطرة.

stem: A 30-year-old man is loudly agitated in the emergency department, pacing and shouting, but he has made no threats and is not violent toward staff. What is the most appropriate first intervention?
options: Immediate physical restraint in the prone position
IM droperidol before any communication is attempted
Asking police to remove him from the department
Verbal de-escalation in a calm, low-stimulus environment
explanationAr: الهياج يُدار أولاً بالتهدئة اللفظية (verbal de-escalation) في بيئة هادئة قليلة المحفزات. وإذا فشلت ذلك تُستخدم أدوية (droperidol أو lorazepam) وقيود بأقل تقييد ممكن (least restrictive) مع مراقبة مستمرة.

stem: A 45-year-old man admitted 48 hours ago for elective surgery becomes tremulous, sweaty, and agitated; he has a heart rate of 118/min, BP 158/96 mmHg, and reports seeing insects crawling on the walls. His family reports heavy daily alcohol use. What is the most appropriate management?
options: Haloperidol monotherapy
Benzodiazepines titrated to the CIWA-Ar scale (for example, lorazepam)
Propranolol alone to control the heart rate
Discharge with advice to abstain from alcohol
explanationAr: هذه أعراض انسحاب كحولي تُعالج بالبنزوديازيبينات (مثل lorazepam) معايرة حسب مقياس CIWA-Ar. يجب مراقبة خطر النوبات الصرعية والهذيان الارتعاشي (delirium tremens) وهو خطر مهدد للحياة.
